title: test(ui): two flaky Test UI cases wait on the effect they read
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb11FQ2fAk48Dv5duBionc2x)_

Fixes #29468

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个今天在 main 上各红过一次的 UI 测试，断言改为等待它真正读取的那个 effect 产出的结果，不再在 DOM 出现后立即同步读取。只改两个测试文件，产品代码不动。
- 为什么改：两处读到的值（Studio 的 beforeunload 守卫、Console 的 /me/apps 请求）都由 React 的 passive effect 写出，而 effect 可能晚于测试等待的那次提交执行；负载高的分片上测试先读到旧值就红了。
- 风险与回滚：仅测试改动，不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。消融验证证明两条断言仍能钉住原卡的行为。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.refusedLeafUnsaved-29113.test.tsx` 新增的 `untilReloadAsks` 及其三处调用；`App.permissionsWave-29114.test.tsx` 第一条用例中新增的 `waitFor(launcherCalls)` 加 `settle()`。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.refusedLeafUnsaved-29113.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/App.permissionsWave-29114.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件、8 条用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two `ui/` test cases that each went red once on `main` today now wait on the outcome they read instead of reading it in the same tick as the DOM marker they awaited. Test-only: no product source changes, no changeset (neither touched file ships: `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and `@object-ui/console` publishes `dist` and its plugin entry only), so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

- `StudioDesignSurface.refusedLeafUnsaved-29113.test.tsx`: a new helper `untilReloadAsks(expected)` wraps the `beforeunload` read in `waitFor`. It replaces the three bare reads that follow an autosave answer or a leaf load (the CI red was the first, line 279).
- `App.permissionsWave-29114.test.tsx`: in the first case, after the home page shows, the test waits for the launcher's `/me/apps` read, then runs the file's own `settle()` before the "exactly once, no duplicate URL" assertions, so a second request would also have time to show.

## Why

The race is the same in both files: **a value written by a React passive effect, read in the tick after the commit the test waited for.**

- Studio: the refusal banner shows in one commit. The pillar reports `refusedUnsent` from an effect (`onDirtyChange`), and the surface installs its `beforeunload` listener from an effect of the render that report causes. `findByTestId('studio-refusal')` resolves on the commit, so `reloadAsks()` can run before either effect has.
- Console: `LauncherAppsProvider` asks `/me/apps` from its effect, which can run after the commit that shows `home-page`.

Testing Library's `waitFor` resolves on the DOM mutation and drains with a 1 ms `setTimeout`. When React's scheduler yields after the commit (render work over its 5 ms frame), the passive effects run from a `setImmediate` continuation. On an idle box that continuation wins; on a loaded box the event loop takes over 1 ms to get back, the drain timer fires first, and the test reads the value before the effect writes it.

This is a test race, not a product race: the guard and the request both happen, just one effect pass after the marker.

## Tests

Reproduced first, at base `8ca9dd7b`, with each test file copied N times into one vitest run (`--maxWorkers=4`, `--sequence.shuffle`) beside node CPU hogs on a 4-core box:

| File · case | Base: red / runs | Fixed: red / runs | Red line (same as CI) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| refusedLeafUnsaved-29113 · "a refused report save makes a reload and the pillar link ask…" | 1 / 80 | 0 / 32 | 279 `expect(reloadAsks()).toBe(true)` |
| permissionsWave-29114 · "the session names the organization…" | 1 / 36 | 0 / 36 | 230 `expect(launcherCalls()).toHaveLength(1)` |

To name the race rather than only count it, a probe preload (`--import`, scratch only, not committed) made React's scheduler continuation (`performWorkUntilDeadline`) run from a timer 2 ms or 3 ms later instead of `setImmediate`, which is what a loaded event loop does to it:

| File | Base: red / runs | Fixed: red / runs |
|:--|:--|:--|
| refusedLeafUnsaved-29113 | 14 / 20 (all at line 279) | 0 / 20 |
| permissionsWave-29114 | 15 / 20 (all at line 230) | 0 / 20 |

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `onDirtyChangeRef.current?.(navDirty || refusedUnsent)` → `(navDirty)`. The fixed file goes red: the target case at `untilReloadAsks(true)`, plus the list-view case. 2 failed, 2 passed.
- `apps/console/src/App.tsx`: `ConsolePermissionsRequest` removed. The fixed file goes red in both early-request cases at `waitFor(permissionsCalls … 1)`. 2 failed, 2 passed.

Whole files on the merged head `3d6225a8`: 2 files, 8 tests, all passed. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint` exit 0, with no warning on either touched file. `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`: 72 tasks, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The shard-sized run used the `--maxWorkers` load beside CPU hogs, not the real `planShards` file set. The scheduler probe shows the mechanism directly.
- The second case of the 29113 file (the rail) did not go red under the ablation. It reads the pillar's own `leafUnsent` during render, not the surface report, so it is synchronous and not part of this race. It is unchanged here.
